authority: 2026-10-02 user Harbor Design Talk Handoff, expressly accepted as new Harbor baseline. Supersedes old HARB naval/export contracts; Military D0034 mechanisms mirrored with D0037 names and explicit Harbor overrides. No numerical or technical gap is filled by Codex.

philosophy.identity: 100% Maritime Commerce + 100% Naval Military, simultaneous full growth; not a choice or two half-strength branches.
philosophy.theme: 利用海洋连接组织船舶、货物、市场与舰队。
philosophy.commerce: 国内价值进入海外市场，开拓不同市场，并引入各文明当前最具代表性的产品。
philosophy.naval: 正式人员、综合训练、远洋保障、经验传授与本地海军传统。

ability_structure.levels_3_4: Two simultaneous sibling institutions at each level: COMMERCIAL and NAVAL. Not mutually exclusive.
ability_structure.naval_mobilization: NOT_ADOPTED; no Commander City or national naval command mirror.

base_effects.level_1: Existing basic Harbor professional support; no independent named ability forced. This handoff does not specify a new support formula.
base_effects.scope: Actual working Harbor specialists where expressly required; empty slots are not working people.
base_effects.legacy_boundary: Old unspecified Great Merchant GPP / marine-improvement-yield wording does not supply a configured bonus or numerical default; see open_details.
base_effects.presentation: Shared Current Identity/Potential institutional presence and ACTIVE ability gating; sibling rows are simultaneous institutions, not a choice.

crew.mirror: Military contracts / MIL_L2_INSTITUTION, Military name 行伍编制
crew.housing: Qualified Harbor district and ordinary buildings provide Housing; Tier-existence mirror, not weighted D. Harbor numerical amounts remain Balance TBD.
crew.gpp: Actual working Harbor specialists provide base Great Admiral Points, not old +15% normal combat XP. Amount follows later mirror balance; no invented Merchant GPP.

port_link.providers: Other own cities with qualified Harbor in the same maritime connectivity network; provider specialization not required.
port_link.local: Retain normal Harbor resource Base adjacency for own-city marine resources; inherited HARB-003 all-city coverage is not silently narrowed to adjacent tiles. Ownership/improvement qualification remains open.
port_link.remote: Raw marine resource facts owned by qualifying providers; first balance test prefers +1 per eligible remote resource, not a frozen value.
port_link.non_recursion: Never read adjacency/yields generated by this Harbor network as new resource input.
port_link.story: Ordinary feeder ports and specialized hub ports bring dispersed marine products into a common port economy.

markets.beneficiary: This Harbor ACTIVE>=3; qualified international maritime routes originating here
markets.N: Number of distinct foreign civilizations maintaining at least one effective qualifying international maritime relation with this port; repeated routes to same civilization count once.
markets.tradeoff: Using a weaker route to open a new market is allowed; only excessive numerical dominance calls for K balancing.
markets.qualification_boundary: Outgoing direction is fixed for rewarded routes. Direction of the relation counted in N and exact foreign-civilization classes require explicit qualification, not an inferred common-network formula.

export.automatic_hinterland: Own city with qualified Harbor and sea reachability to this Lv4 Harbor.
export.domestic_hinterland: Other own city unable to auto-connect must have an effective domestic Trade Route connecting it to this Lv4 Harbor; direction not specified.
export.input: Base Adjacency of eligible districts in connected cities. Eligible domains/yield mapping and exact aggregation remain open.
export.dependency: Base Adjacency → Export Value → International Maritime Trade Route
export.prototype_only: K_E * sum BaseAdjacency is a candidate, not a frozen curve; low-rate linear, piecewise diminishing and sublinear may be compared.
export.application: Add Export Value to each qualified international maritime route from this port, then combine with Lv3 market diversity multiplier. Yield allocation remains TBD.
export.design_intent: Destination Value describes the foreign city; Export Value describes goods the port needs to sell. Export may exceed native Destination Value; large export-led or dumping-like expansion is allowed, not automatically a design defect.
export.replaced: Old higher-rate own-city Actual/local branch is superseded; no implicit self Actual Yield exception.

import.scope: At most one special import supply per connected foreign civilization per port; multiple routes to that civilization do not multiply supplies. Not fixed Luxury.
import.production: Not included: no clean comparable civilization-level total Production interface assumed. This is not a proven engine impossibility.
import.relation_0_to_1: Read partner metrics and current other major-civilization comparison context; classify its most outstanding relative domain and lock this supply type.
import.relation_positive: Supply type stays locked while at least one qualifying international maritime relation remains.
import.relation_1_to_0: Remove the supply. A future 0→1 classifies anew using the new world situation.
import.anti_reroll: NOT_ADOPTED: no era lock or extra protection. Design rationale assumes no ordinary zero-cost freely cancelable running route; natural expiry/nonrenewal, war, pillage, trader loss/capacity changes bear actual costs.
import.classifier: UNFROZEN; candidate Score_y = AI_y / Median_y. Median is relatively robust to outliers and preserves lead magnitude beyond rank; metric comparability and zero/tie/world-pool rules require investigation.
import.effects: Each supply type effect remains Balance TBD.
import.story: 万国所长，由海而来：商品、器物、技术产品、文化产品、宗教用品、军需等，而不是不同颜色的同一种奢侈品。

operating.eligible_turn: This port ACTIVE IV and at least one effective maritime Trade Route running for the city that turn; domestic and international both qualify.
operating.route_count: 1 or 8 routes still yield exactly +1 time; large empires cannot buy history instantly with many Traders.
operating.rejected: Completed-route count: favors short trips and penalizes genuinely distant routes.
operating.milestones: Increasing discrete accumulated operating-time thresholds; each reached milestone permanently awards +1 Trade Route Capacity.
operating.curve: UNFROZEN; prototype candidate T_n = C*n*(n+1)/2, C=6 gives 6/18/36/60/90/126. Neither curve nor C is frozen; later milestones may be too slow.
operating.pause: Loss of ACTIVE IV pauses operating progress, never resets it.
operating.earned_capacity: Permanent once earned; Governor movement or temporary ACTIVE IV loss does not revoke it.
operating.intent: Settler/Potential investment sacrifices horizontal expansion while maritime markets/hinterland/import/export consume route capacity. Long-running ports grow their own shipping industry, personnel, families, credit, agencies, insurance, storage and fleet institutions. Moving a Governor to develop a new port is allowed institutional diffusion.
operating.boundary: Route direction for the running-route predicate and ownership/respecialization/destruction Legacy are not silently resolved.

naval_mirror.source: Military_D0037.json contracts, unchanged Military D0034 mechanics
included: unit_eligibility adapted from land to qualified naval combat units
comprehensive_training with Harbor numerical balance explicitly TBD
logistics with naval support mapping TBD
military_tradition with Great Admiral and local Naval Tradition
naval_mirror.unit_eligibility: Naval combat scope; production and Gold/Faith acquisition mirror current Military. Free/levied/duplicated/captured only with reliably confirmed training-city origin; otherwise excluded. Exact naval type coverage/attribution remains investigation; no civilian naval expansion.
naval_mirror.unit_snapshot: At eligible grant, freeze current ACTIVE entitlement, actual working Harbor specialists E_birth and applicable local Tradition enhancement. Later city ACTIVE/specialist/Tradition changes do not retroactively revalue the unit. P and nearby mentors remain current combat facts; merged units retain maximum same-ability effect, never sum/average; distinct abilities remain separate. Upgrade/formation implementation and unit ownership Legacy are unconfirmed.
naval_mirror.efficiency_exception: City training efficiency is a local effect, not a permanent unit-held birth buff.

training.breadth: Eligible completed/unpillaged ordinary T1 presence provides new naval unit quality. Bare district / D>0 / higher-tier-only cannot substitute for T1. Harbor conversion amounts explicitly remain TBD in this handoff; no automatic final +1/+5 parameter transplant.
training.depth: Same domains use Absolute Infrastructure Depth D to improve local training efficiency; T1-only no efficiency, T2-stage begins; no 100% completion or D10 gate. Current Military unresolved precise onset/aggregation/curve/cap/speed/purchase applicability retained.
training.qualification: Shared ordinary ontology, replacements/free buildings and highest-single-district D per domain; no Harbor/other-domain addition.
training.interaction: Existing eligible infrastructure can qualify; city breadth versus depth remains a meaningful investment choice.

logistics.effect: Formal naval support/supply; certain ongoing strategic resource maintenance may be replaced with Gold maintenance; upfront production/purchase/upgrade resource costs unchanged.
logistics.direction: Mirror the physical paid support and visible 1:1 escort direction, not an adopted abstract fallback. Exact naval support ship/coverage/unlocks/linkage require investigation; uranium and costs retain unresolved status.
logistics.not_inferred: No extra tile occupancy, new resupply mechanics or support-ship design supplied by this handoff.

mentorship.fighter: Own eligible naval combat unit with entitlement; not restricted to zero promotions.
mentorship.mentor: Adjacent one-hex own eligible naval combat unit of same PromotionClass with more actual promotions; choose maximum P, not sum; flagship not required.
mentorship.xp: Independent bonus at qualifying real combat, no normal Combat XP multiplier, no E cap or extra artificial cap. Local Tradition enhancements snapshot at grant; values unresolved.
mentorship.technical_boundary: Combat timing/exceptional combat/upgrade/formation remain investigated separately.

insight.E: Actual working Harbor specialist count fixed in unit training snapshot at eligible acquisition, not empty slots or later source-city count.
insight.P: Current actual promotions, including lawful formation inheritance, not XP level.
insight.xp: Independent extra combat XP; no override of native ordinary XP cap and no inherited universal cap8/E<=4. Not immediate XP payout at birth; naval balance remains pending.

tradition.action: Great Admiral may be consumed in this Harbor city to institutionalize local Naval Tradition, foregoing its native one-time retirement effect; no simultaneous native retirement reward.
tradition.ownership: Local city historical asset, not national or automatic Network payload.
tradition.application: Future eligible naval units inherit snapshotted birth-CS / Mentorship / Insight enhancements; no retroactive aura.
tradition.tiers: Mirror finite discrete tiers, each strengthens one of these three; approximately six is Military design direction, not locked Harbor count; thresholds/order/increments remain TBD.
tradition.era: No new different-era Admiral requirement imposed by the mirror.
tradition.legacy: Respecialization/owner change boundaries remain separate; no universal permanent-asset inheritance rule.

crew_housing.candidate: Military-mirror direction, no fixed Harbor amount

crew_admiral_gpp.candidate: Base GPP per working specialist, amount unset

export_function.candidate: K_E * sum BaseAdjacency is only a simplest prototype

operating_milestones.candidate: T_n=C*n*(n+1)/2; C6 sequence6/18/36/60/90/126 is illustrative, not default

naval_quality.candidate: Military mechanism mirror; Harbor values TBD

naval_efficiency.candidate: Same unresolved structure as current Military

Direction and civilization classes for foreign relation counts; direction of domestic hinterland connection and maritime operating-time eligibility
Eligible export districts, port self-contribution, heterogeneous/negative Base Adjacency aggregation and yield distribution
Old HARB-002 unspecified Great Merchant points/marine-improvement yield language has no new assigned level/formula; do not invent or declare a separate confirmed ability from it
Supply classifier tie/zero/missing values and precise comparison population; preserve locked type lifecycle without inventing classification
technical_investigation: Actual sea-connected topology/cache and Canal treatment
Read interfaces for six civilization-wide metrics; Median/alternative algorithm
Naval support/logistics implementation and current Military unit snapshot/merge/combat interfaces
open_details.name_maturity: READY_TO_FREEZE means user label 可冻结, not an automatic LOCKED name; STRONG_CANDIDATE/TENTATIVE/PLACEHOLDER remain separate from accepted mechanism. 船政局 remains STRONG_FREEZE_CANDIDATE.

Local Naval Tradition on identity/owner changes; awarded unit buffs follow explicit snapshot contract
Unit ownership/capture beyond confirmed acquisition attribution; support ships after source changes
Institution historical presentation follows Shared/per-specialization Legacy, not carrier ownership
